records.title: Export size policy
records.text: Export files above 50 MB exceed the supported limit. This policy applies only to version 2.3.

records.title: Export size policy
records.text: Export files up to 100 MB are supported. Larger jobs require batch export. This policy applies to version 2.4.

records.title: Restricted workspace export exception
records.text: Restricted workspaces require administrator review before any export, even below the usual size limit.

records.title: Password reset expiration
records.text: Password reset links expire after thirty minutes. Request a fresh link for a local account. Enterprise SSO is an exception.

records.title: Enterprise authentication
records.text: Enterprise SSO authentication is owned by the identity administrator. Local password reset does not change an SSO credential.

records.title: Duplicate invoice review
records.text: Compare invoice identifiers and settlement status before confirming a duplicate payment. Refunds are not guaranteed before review.

records.title: Pending card authorization
records.text: A pending authorization and settled payment are different states. A pending entry does not independently prove duplicate settlement.

records.title: Export newsletter
records.text: Our newsletter discusses export success stories and download usage statistics. It does not define customer troubleshooting policy.

records.title: Unresolved export policy draft
records.text: An unapproved draft proposes a 75 MB export limit for version 2.4. Its applicability conflicts with the approved policy and requires review.

records.title: Export size policy copy
records.text: Export files up to 100 MB are supported. Larger jobs require batch export. Copy of EXPORT-CURRENT; not independent evidence.
